newsitem.title: USA: Right Management OKs stock repurchase plan.
newsitem.headline: Right Management OKs stock repurchase plan.

text.p: Right Management Consultants Inc said Thursday it approved a program to repurchase up to 10 percent of its outstanding common.
The company said it has about 6,567,000 shares currently outstanding.

Any shares repurchased will be held as treasury shares and be available to the company for use in various benefit plans and, when authorized by the board, for other general corporate purposes, the company said.
The board has authorized company management to pursue the repurchase program in open market transactions from time-to-time, depending upon market conditions and other factors, the company said.
